text.title: 声音室里较安静的角落
text.goal: 声音室里较安静的角落
text.situation:
声音室在厚门后。展牌介绍声学，屏幕以分贝显示声级。工作人员把录制声音调到另一档时，乔站着不动。这次变化可察觉，足够明显；另一次很小的变化则被说明为对本演示可忽略。图表用 magnitude 表示测量差异的大小。另一标签标出警示灯亮起的阈值。玛雅读到研究者写的“统计上不显著”结果，注意到这并不是说整个实验不重要。

乔：不显著意味着结果没用吗？
工作人员：这份说明写统计上不显著，是关于分析的判断。
玛雅：那警示灯呢？
工作人员：它有自己的阈值，写在那张标签上。

paragraphs.en: The sound room was behind a heavy door. A board introduced acoustics, while a screen displayed a sound level in decibels. Jo stood still as the attendant moved a recorded sound to another setting. The change was appreciable, large enough to notice, although a separate tiny variation was described as negligible for that demonstration. A chart used magnitude for the size of a measured difference. Another label marked a threshold at which a warning light would come on. Maya read a researcher’s note about a statistically insignificant result and noticed that it did not simply say the whole experiment was unimportant.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: Does insignificant mean the result is useless?
Attendant: This note says statistically insignificant. That is a statement about the analysis.
Maya: And the warning light?
Attendant: It has its own threshold, shown on that label.

S04.G12.P02.function: A quieter corner of the sound room
S04.G12.P02.cue: 比较可察觉和很小的变化。
acceptableAnswers: 这点变化在本演示中可忽略。 图表展示差异的大小。

S04.G12.P03.function: A quieter corner of the sound room
S04.G12.P03.cue: 说明差异大小和警示界限。
acceptableAnswers: 灯在标记阈值处亮起。 说明描述一个统计上不显著的结果。

S04.G12.T01.function: A quieter corner of the sound room
S04.G12.T01.cue: 差异对当前目的太小而不必计入，描述它。
